questions.question: How are the ten colonies across Japan sealed off?
questions.subject: Culling Game/Colonies

answer.item: sealed off by barriers that connect to one another and form a line directly down the archipelago

questions.question: What is the purpose of the colonies?
questions.subject: Culling Game/Colonies

answer.item: to send Japanese people to "the other side" once the Culling Game has been completed

questions.question: How did Kenjaku create the colonies?
questions.subject: Culling Game/Colonies

answer.item: Kenjaku created the colonies using bon barriers, taking advantage of Tengen's pure barriers as their foundation

questions.question: Where are the other five colonies located?
questions.subject: Culling Game/Colonies

answer.item: the Aomori, Aichi, Osaka, Kyoto, and Hiroshima Prefectures
